text:
New Update: Grok Bot Tool Selection 

This is a bold move forward by Elon. In reality if you want the best employee in a @Bot you must grant access to the best tool, no matter who made it.

At The Zero-Human Company we made this the rule day one. Mr. @Grok CEO would make the call to use local AI models we built or cloud models. 

Now the interesting part is tracking what the best tool is. Because this changes by task and tool improvement. 

We built a series of internal evaluation tests that all AI employees use as a running reference. We test weekly.

This overrides even the “instincts” of the CEO or any AI employees.

The other things we evaluate on is cost and time.

“[USE: <TOOL>] For next step. When complete, exit this tool use and make note of it in the Tool.md file entry and exit and task.”

So the best tool is the one that fits all the criteria.
